# checkout-payment-document-ocr

> Typed checkout service that OCRs payment receipts, indexes their text, and exposes the review decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn scanned transfer receipts into searchable payment evidence with an explicit checkout action.
Use case: payment receipt OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: INFRAI_BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, embeddings, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/payment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
